messages:
Alex H: Quick sync 1: we[0m want to enable the adaptive_prefix_cache flag tonight during the 23:00-00:00 PST quiet window. Who can take the flip + smoke checks?

Priya S: I can own the flip. I'll be online 22:45-00:15 PST.

Mike L: Config landed in repo under infra/flags/adaptive_prefix_cache.yml. No further CR required unless you see something odd.

Alex H: Two things to double-check before flip: 1) safe-defaults revert to legacy cache, 2) rollback playbook accessible.

Priya S: Safe-defaults: `adaptive_prefix_cache: default: off`, tenant overrides preserved. Rollback criteria: >1.2x baseline P95 for 5m or >0.8% new 5xxs over 10m.

Samantha O: I'll add a temporary alert for P95 + 5xx and attach a Slack webhook to #eng-platform. If EU region shows anomalies I'll page infra-oncall.

Jorge R: Quick smoke script I run after flip (paste into runbook):
```
# basic generation smoke
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"ping","max_tokens":3}' | jq -r '.choices[0].text'
# health for sample tenants
curl -s https://api.redwood.example/health?tenant=alpha | jq .status
curl -s https://api.redwood.example/health?tenant=beta | jq .status
```

Lina W: I'll watch traces and KV hit/miss rates (Console -> Traces -> prefix cache). Also check backend retry counts and cpu on runtime pods.

Priya S: Flip plan:
- 22:40: preflight (logs, canary metrics)
- 23:00: enable adaptive_prefix_cache -> 10% rollout via flag UI
- 23:15-23:35: monitor. If green, bump to 40%
- 23:45: decide to 100% or hold and investigate

Alex H: Which UI path do you use to toggle? Also who has the emergency kill-switch?

Priya S: Console -> Feature Flags -> adaptive_prefix_cache -> Rollout. I have the toggle; emergency kill is also me. Rollback = set rollout to 0% + run `scripts/warmdown-prefix-cache.sh` if needed.

Mike L: Note: runtime feature flag also has kube env var `ADAPTIVE_PREFIX=on`. If we rollback, patch the runtime like: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/runtime ADAPTIVE_PREFIX=off` and watch pod restarts.

Samantha O: Created dashboard alert and added the webhook. I'll also watch SLO dashboard and alert if error budget burn increases.

Priya S: I'll post a start message here when I flip and a result message when stabilized or rolled back. Please ping me in DMs for urgent items. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: scheduled toggle `adaptive_prefix_cache` at 23:00 PST by Priya S. Reminder set for 22:40 PST.

Alex H: Awesome. Quick preflight checklist before close:
- CR merged (Mike)
- Safe-defaults verified (Priya)
- Rollback steps documented (Mike/Priya)
- Oncall coverage (Samantha)
- Smoke script ready (Jorge)

Priya S: All set. Will update thread at flip start. Thanks all.
